slides.title: Introduction
slides.content:
# spaCy 📝

Fast NLP library!

```python
import spacy

nlp = spacy.load('en_core_web_sm')
doc = nlp('Apple is looking at buying U.K. startup')

for token in doc:
    print(token.text, token.pos_, token.dep_)
```

> 💡 **Optimized for production!**

slides.title: NER & POS
slides.content:
# Named Entity Recognition 🏷️

```python
doc = nlp('Apple CEO Tim Cook visited Paris')

# Named entities
for ent in doc.ents:
    print(ent.text, ent.label_)
# Apple (ORG), Tim Cook (PERSON), Paris (GPE)

# Noun chunks
for chunk in doc.noun_chunks:
    print(chunk.text)
```
